jobs.name: Compose LinkedIn draft (no auto-post)
jobs.description: Open LinkedIn share box and type the top scored draft. Dry-run types text and does NOT click Post. Publish only with CONTENT_DO_PUBLISH=true and --no-dry-run.

jobs.name: Generate scored LinkedIn post drafts
jobs.description: For each researched topic, generate 3–5 angled LinkedIn posts, score them, and persist drafts (never publishes).

jobs.name: LinkedIn content engine pipeline
jobs.description: Research topics → generate & score drafts → optional LinkedIn compose (Post not clicked in dry-run). Artifacts under data/content/<runId>/.

jobs.name: Research LinkedIn content topics
jobs.description: Generate authority-building LinkedIn topic ideas (AI when configured, else curated templates). Persists topics.json under data/content/<runId>/.

jobs.name: Dedupe lead companies and people
jobs.description: Dedupe companies/people by normalized name + LinkedIn URL within the run (and optional prior outputs).

jobs.name: Discover lead companies
jobs.description: Find companies that may need software/IT consulting via LinkedIn search (web fallback/seed in dry-run).

jobs.name: Draft outreach messages
jobs.description: Template-based personalized LinkedIn/email outreach for qualified leads.

jobs.name: Enrich lead companies
jobs.description: Enrich companies from LinkedIn company pages and public websites.

jobs.name: Export leads
jobs.description: Export qualified leads + outreach to CSV and JSON under output/leads/<runId>/.

jobs.name: Find decision makers
jobs.description: Find decision makers: website leadership crawl, sequential web SERP→LinkedIn /in/, filtered LI company employees, optional global LI search. Site visits low-concurrency; search engines sequential; LinkedIn sequential.

jobs.name: Follow up accepted LinkedIn connects
jobs.description: After lead-send-outreach connects: check pending vs accepted profiles and send a short LinkedIn DM when Message is available. Default dry-run — not in pipeline.

jobs.name: Lead gen pipeline
jobs.description: Runs the full lead chain in one process: discover → dedupe → enrich → tech-signals → find-decision-makers → suppress → verify → qualify → draft → export.

jobs.name: Qualify leads
jobs.description: Score buying signals, recommend a service, and write qualified leads.json.

jobs.name: Send LinkedIn connect outreach
jobs.description: Connect-only by default: send LinkedIn connection requests (optional note) for drafted leads. Email only if LEAD_SEND_EMAIL=true. Default dry-run — not in pipeline.

jobs.name: Apply suppress lists
jobs.description: Skip companies/people in suppress lists (customers / already contacted).

jobs.name: Collect tech / buying signals
jobs.description: Scan careers/stack/vendor pages for stronger buying signals.

jobs.name: Verify contacts lightly
jobs.description: Lightweight verify: website responds, LinkedIn URL shape; optional DNS MX for emails.

jobs.name: Invite connections to follow Lanatus
jobs.description: Monthly-paced LinkedIn Page invites to follow Lanatus Systems (admin Invite to follow).

jobs.name: Apply to Naukri jobs one by one
jobs.description: Apply to listed jobs sequentially (Naukri site apply). Default dry-run — not in default pipeline.

jobs.name: Export Naukri jobs
jobs.description: Export jobs.json to CSV/JSON under output/naukri/<runId>/.

jobs.name: Naukri job search pipeline
jobs.description: search jobs → export list. Apply is separate (review first).

jobs.name: Search Naukri jobs
jobs.description: Search Naukri by role×geo, filter by keywords, write jobs.json under data/naukri/<runId>/.

jobs.name: Draft referral connect notes and DMs
jobs.description: Pair people with jobs at their company and attach static connect note + referral message. Writes targets.json.

jobs.name: Export referral jobs and targets
jobs.description: Export jobs + drafted targets to CSV/JSON under output/referral/<runId>/.

jobs.name: Find recruiters and peers at job companies
jobs.description: For companies from jobs.json: find recruiters/talent first, then similar-role peers. Writes people.json.

jobs.name: Follow up accepted connects with referral DM
jobs.description: After referral-send-connect: when Message is available, send static referral DM. Default dry-run — not in pipeline.

jobs.name: Referral job hunt pipeline
jobs.description: search jobs → find people → draft → export. Connect and follow-up are separate (review first).

jobs.name: Search LinkedIn jobs for referral targets
jobs.description: Search LinkedIn Jobs by role×geo, open JDs, keep postings matching REFERRAL_JD_KEYWORDS. Writes jobs.json.

jobs.name: Send LinkedIn connect for referral targets
jobs.description: Send connection requests (optional note) for drafted referral targets. Default dry-run — not in pipeline.

jobs.name: Draft visibility posts
jobs.description: Draft LinkedIn posts for personal brand visibility (AI, automation, IT consulting, custom software). Never auto-publishes.

jobs.name: Engage on posts
jobs.description: Scroll content human-like; like when relevance is solid; comment only when score is high. Dry-run: react yes, type comment without sending.

jobs.name: Find posts for visibility
jobs.description: Search LinkedIn content for AI/automation/IT consulting/custom software posts to engage with (personal brand visibility).

jobs.name: Visibility pipeline
jobs.description: Content-first LinkedIn visibility: search posts → like/comment; connect only on strong software-dev lead fit. Set VISIBILITY_TARGETED=true for optional ICP people mode.

jobs.name: Visibility — targeted people engage
jobs.description: ICP people search → view profiles → meaningful comments + reacts on their posts → optional personalized connects. Preferred over keyword content scrolling.
